summary: Sprint 5 — Push Notification Center tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/30 pytest cases PASS (5 fail — 4 real bugs + 1 test-path assumption already fixed). Admin UI: 4-tab console (Compose / Campaigns / Analytics / Audit) renders correctly and hits all admin endpoints — verified visually. FOUND 4 SERVER-SIDE BUGS THAT MUST BE FIXED: (1) CRITICAL: /api/notifications/preferences GET & PUT are ROUTE-SHADOWED by legacy push.py handlers (/app/backend/push.py:109 & :122) that were registered before notifications_module in server.py (push_module.attach at line 992 vs notifications_module.attach at line 1061). Because FastAPI honours the first-registered handler, the new 9-key preference model (wallet_alerts, investment_alerts, ai_alerts, marketing, security_alerts, system_notifications, push_enabled, email_enabled, sms_enabled) is UNREACHABLE — GET returns only 5 legacy keys {transactions, rewards, promotional, security, push_enabled} and PUT persists to non-matching keys. This also makes the preference-gating feature non-functional: setting marketing=false via /api/notifications/preferences no longer mutes promotions because the write lands under a legacy key, not `marketing`. (2) HIGH: Scheduled campaigns crash with HTTP 500 — TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at notifications_module.py:357 (`body.schedule_at > _now()`). _now() returns naive utcnow() but Pydantic parses `schedule_at` as tz-aware. Fix: use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` OR strip tz on schedule_at. Blocks compose with schedule_at (test 17). Also affects the /cancel path indirectly (can't produce a scheduled campaign to cancel). (3) HIGH: Audit log write path is broken — notifications_module calls `_log_action(user_id=..., action=..., meta=...)` (kwarg `user_id`) but admin.py:131 signature is `_log_action(admin_id, action, target, meta)` — kwarg mismatch raises TypeError which is caught silently in the try/except. As a result NO notif_campaign_create / notif_campaign_resend entries are ever persisted. (4) HIGH: Audit READ endpoint queries the wrong collection — notifications_module.py:480 reads `_db.audit_logs.find(...).sort('ts', -1)` but the real collection is `_db.admin_audit` (see admin.py:132) and the sort field is `at`, not `ts`. So the Admin UI Audit tab always shows 'No audit entries yet.' — confirmed visually. Beyond these 4 bugs, EVERYTHING ELSE WORKS: listing/filter (category/unread_only/q/limit/skip) ✓, per_category (11 keys) ✓, unread-count ✓, mark-one-read + 404 ✓, bulk mark-read ✓, delete-one + 404 ✓, clear-all ✓, compose target_type=all/user/segment (all 4 segments) ✓, compose 404 for missing user ✓, resend ✓, campaign list + status/q filter ✓, campaign detail with delivered/opened/ctr_pct ✓, analytics (totals, 7-day chart, per_category) ✓, invalid category/target 400 ✓, admin bearer required ✓, existing _notify_user path still writes into notification center and category filter surfaces the item ✓. Admin UI: all 4 tabs visible, Compose has title/body (with BODY (0/1000) counter)/category dropdown/priority/deeplink/image/action label + live Preview panel on right, Campaigns table shows 18 rows with campaign_id, target (segment/user), sent/opened, SENT status badge, Analytics shows 5 stat cards (Sent 71, Delivered 67, Opened 0, Failed 0, CTR 0%) + 7-day Sent-vs-Opened chart + By Category progress bars, Audit tab shows the empty-state (due to bug #3/#4).

critical.issue: Route shadowed by legacy push.py handlers — new 9-key preferences model is completely unreachable & preference gating (marketing→promotions mute) fails. Fix: remove GET & PUT handlers from /app/backend/push.py:109-129 (leave only /notifications/register token endpoints) OR flip attach order. Reference: push.py:109, push.py:122; server.py:992 vs 1061.

minor.issue: HTTP 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. notifications_module.py:357 — _now() is naive utcnow() but body.schedule_at arrives tz-aware from Pydantic. Fix: `body.schedule_at.replace(tzinfo=None) > _now()` OR change _now() to `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` and store tz-aware everywhere. Priority: HIGH.

notifications_module.py:373 calls _log_action(user_id=..., action=..., meta=...) but admin.py:131 signature is _log_action(admin_id, action, target, meta). TypeError is silently swallowed → NO notif_ audit rows are ever persisted. Fix: call `_log_action(admin['admin_id'], 'notif_campaign_create', meta={...})`. Priority: HIGH.

Queries wrong collection & wrong sort field. notifications_module.py:480 uses _db.audit_logs.find(...).sort('ts', -1) but real collection is _db.admin_audit and field is `at`. Endpoint always returns []. Fix: `_db.admin_audit.find({'action': {'$regex': '^notif_'}}).sort('at', -1)`. Priority: HIGH.

ui_bugs.issue: Always shows 'No audit entries yet.' due to backend bug #3/#4 above. Not a UI defect per se — root cause is server-side.

No data-testid attributes on tab buttons, form fields, or table rows — automation had to rely on text-based selectors. Adding testIDs (compose-title, compose-body, tab-campaigns, campaign-row, etc.) would harden E2E.

integration_issues.issue: User cannot change new-model preferences via the app because /api/notifications/preferences is shadowed by push.py — the 9-key PUT ends up in the wrong document keys, so admin promotions campaigns are NOT muted even when the mobile UI shows 'marketing=off'.

action_items: P0 — Remove or rename the legacy /api/notifications/preferences GET & PUT handlers in /app/backend/push.py (lines 109-129). Keep only the /notifications/register (token registration) endpoints there. Restart backend and confirm `curl /api/notifications/preferences` returns the 9-key model.

P1 — Fix audit endpoint (notifications_module.py:480) to query `_db.admin_audit` and sort by `at`, matching admin.py's audit collection.

critical_code_review_comments: Route shadowing is a general risk: two modules currently register the same URL (`/api/notifications/preferences`). FastAPI silently accepts both — consider adding a `@app.on_event('startup')` sanity check that logs duplicate route paths.
notifications_module.py uses `datetime.utcnow()` (naive) throughout, but ingests tz-aware datetimes from Pydantic. Pick one convention project-wide.
Audit logging is fire-and-forget under try/except pass, which hid the real _log_action signature mismatch. Prefer logging the exception at WARNING level so bugs like this surface immediately.

Compose dispatch uses `asyncio.create_task(_dispatch_campaign(...))` — the task is not awaited or tracked; if the process restarts mid-fanout the campaign is orphaned in status='sending'. For 'all' targeting on a real user base this could leak. Consider a background queue or persist to a `dispatch_queue` collection.

In `_resolve_target` for kyc_pending/kyc_approved, the module unions `users.kyc_status` with `kyc_profiles.status`. Since server.py may also update `users.kyc_status`, these sources can drift — worth documenting the canonical source.
notifications_module.py is 521 lines — under the 700-line limit, healthy split (helpers, user router, admin router, scheduler) already in place. Good.

rca_of_issue:
Four independent bugs traced to code inspection and confirmed by backend traceback + JSON payload diff:

(1) ROUTE SHADOW — /app/backend/push.py:109 & :122 register GET & PUT /notifications/preferences during push_module.attach() (server.py L992). The new notifications_module.attach() at L1061 registers the same paths with the 9-key model, but FastAPI serves the FIRST-registered handler. Reproduce: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <user>' /api/notifications/preferences` returns {transactions, rewards, promotional, security, push_enabled} instead of the new 9-key body. Mitigation: delete or rename the two handlers in push.py; the mobile & admin clients already assume the new schema.

(2) TZ COMPARISON — Traceback captured in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: `File .../notifications_module.py, line 357, in admin_compose: scheduled = body.schedule_at is not None and body.schedule_at > _now() → TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Reproduce: POST /api/admin/notifications/compose with `schedule_at: '<ISO 8601 with +00:00>'`. Mitigation: strip tzinfo before compare or make _now() tz-aware.

(3) AUDIT WRITE — _log_action is imported from admin.py which defines signature `(admin_id: str, action: str, target=None, meta=None)`. notifications_module.py:373 calls `_log_action(user_id=doc['created_by'], action=..., meta=...)`. The mismatched kwarg raises `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'user_id'` which is swallowed by the surrounding try/except pass. Reproduce: any compose call succeeds (200) but no row appears in db.admin_audit. Mitigation: `await _log_action(doc['created_by'], 'notif_campaign_create', meta={...})`.

(4) AUDIT READ — notifications_module.py:480 reads `_db.audit_logs.find(...).sort('ts', -1)` but admin.py:132 writes to `_db.admin_audit` with sort field `at`. Reproduce: `GET /api/admin/notifications/audit` returns `{'items': []}` even when other admin actions have been logged. Mitigation: read from `_db.admin_audit` and sort by `at`, OR align the write collection to `audit_logs` and use `ts` field — but the former is less invasive since admin.py already has a working audit list endpoint reading from admin_audit.
